interface.shortDescription: AI visibility + site audits: see if ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude & Gemini recommend a website.
interface.longDescription: Ask whether AI assistants actually recommend your business. Website Auditor puts the questions a real customer would ask to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity, reports which businesses get named, and adds SEO, security-header, broken-link and performance checks — an overall AI-visibility score (0-100), a per-engine breakdown, competitor comparisons, and ongoing monitoring. Try it before subscribing: the sample report needs no API key and no setup.
defaultPrompt: Show me a sample website audit report
Check whether ChatGPT and other AI assistants recommend my website
Audit my website's AI visibility, SEO, security and performance
